claim_boundary: Rank lower bounds, not exact ranks. Logarithms/heights are rounded approximations. Includes already-public matches and one public-point rank28 reproduction. Finite exported examples only; no literature-wide novelty claim.

height_convention.faltings_height: -1/2 log(period lattice area) on global minimal model, matching ICARM; Sage stable=False
height_convention.minimality: Generic local minimization at2,3 and every prime dividing gcd(c4,c6), whose factorization is bounded by10^7. Outside these primes at least one invariant is a unit, precluding a smaller integral model.
height_convention.naive_height: log max(abs(c4)^3,c6^2) on global minimal model
